notes.title: Update With A Small Fix
notes.notes:
This update is just a small fix for a location in the intro level where it was possible to get stuck in the geometry if you were really testing the edges of the game. Since we actively try to encourage this in players, we wanted to address it even though it is a pretty rare occurrence.

We are grateful to everyone who has given [i]The Magic Circle[/i] a chance, and welcome to the new players who found us during the daily deal! Hope you enjoy the game.

-Question

notes.title: Update With Some Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Today we are updating with an important (if very rare) bugfix. There was an issue where *spoilers ahead* [spoiler]damage done by the parasite ability did not properly send life back into the crack system[/spoiler]. This [i]could[/i] be made into a spiral of fail (by a truly dedicated player) that might create an impossible to recover from resource situation.  We have a fix, as well as an attempt to correct the problem in save files of affected players.

Special thanks to Jetz on the forums, who spent a lot of time isolating the problem and sent us incredibly useful save files and repro steps. The bug was rare enough that no one else has ever reported it, but Jetz pushed the system as far as it would go and uncovered the issue.

As always, we are super grateful to our awesome players. Thanks for checking out the game and hope you have enjoyed it!

-Question

notes.title: Ides of March Update, IGF Nomination, and SXSW!
notes.notes:
This update has a bunch of miscellaneous tweaks and fixes to various systems as well as some usability improvements. Some of the highlights include improvements in the way music is delivered, D-Pad support in all parts of mindspace (for our gamepad players), some AI improvements, and some unobtrusive control reminders if we detect you have been away from the game for a while. The full list can be seen in the Tech Support forum.

In addition, [i]The Magic Circle[/i] is up for an Excellence in Narrative award at this year's IGF! If you are at GDC come say hi to rujuro and Nullspeak in the IGF area, if not you can still watch the awards live on twitch the evening of March 16th.

[b]And there's still more![/b] KainAsylum will be showing the game at SXSW in Austin, TX where we are up for the Gamer's Voice Award.  If you are going to be there stop by, say hi, and maybe vote for us if it's the kind of thing you'd like to do.

Thanks again to everyone who has played the game, we are extremely grateful for your support.

-Question

notes.title: Update With Numerous Small Fixes and Tweaks
notes.notes:
The biggest change in this update is some significant work on pathfinding to make it smoother and more predictable, especially in the endgame sequence.  What was there before worked fine, but we were never completely happy with it, so we took this opportunity to make it better.

There are also a number of small geometry and texture tweaks, as well as some fixes to how the player behaves in certain collision situations. Please let us know if you see anything bizarre! As always the full change list can be seen in the Tech Support Forum.

Thanks again to all the players who have given [i]The Magic Circle[/i] a chance, we appreciate it and hope you enjoyed the game!

-Question

We hope this makes the game accessible to even more players. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update #8: Major Addition To The End Of The Game!
notes.notes:
Without spoiling too much, we have just updated [i]The Magic Circle[/i] with a bunch of new content for the final section of the game!  There are now nearly [b]twice[/b] as many options available there, which is something that a number of players have requested since we launched. In particular a [i]hidden[/i] aesthetic from the main game is now properly represented :).

In addition to the new content, there are also a number of usability tweaks and small bug fixes bundled in with this update as well.  As always you can find the  full update notes in the forums.

Thanks to all the people who have given the game a shot, it has been a blast seeing how much you enjoy it!

-Question

notes.title: Post-PAX Prime 2015 Update
notes.notes:
It was great meeting so many people at PAX Prime 2015 who liked [i]The Magic Circle[/i] and genuinely want to see us succeed enough to make another game.

Special thanks goes out to those who bought the game directly from us at the booth. Your submitted names now manifest in the game as promised.

[h1]September 4th Update Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]fix for controller dpad issues with the combobox in the options screen
[*]fix for being able to attempt ally summon during Pro Mode title invitation
[*]fix for being able to bring up the map during overworld intro tunnel
[*]Added preferred names from folks who purchased The Magic Circle directly from our booth during PAX Prime 2015. These names will show up [spoiler]As SkyBastards from the internet popping in once TMC goes open source[/spoiler] Names from early access superusers were kept in this list
[/list]

notes.title: Update #9 Is Live! Language Localization!
notes.notes:
One of the final pre-launch updates has gone live.  

The [b]BIG FEATURE[/b] in this update is localized subtitles and interface for the following languages:
[b]German
Italian
Spanish
French[/b]

We would love feedback from any of our existing multi-lingual customers regarding any issues or quality feedback. It's really important to us that [i]The Magic Circle[/i] is available to as many people as possible, and supporting languages other than English is a huge part of that.

In addition we have some new functionality with waypoints, footstep sounds, and many small tweaks and fixes.

As always, full patch notes will be posted in the Tech Support forum.

notes.title: Pricing Changes
notes.notes:
In preparation for our launch on this [b]Thursday the 9th[/b], we are changing the pricing for the game. Going forward the deluxe edition (the early access version with soundtrack) will be $24.99 US, and the base edition will be $19.99.

EDIT: Valve came through - Base Edition is now available. However!

There will be launch discounts, so you might want to wait until Thursday to purchase to take advantage of those.

Thanks!
